[engine] A reading that is identical in every arm cannot be evidence about which arm you are in. Before using a log line to prove a state change, check that it actually varies with that state -- otherwise you are quoting a planned/target value as a measurement.

**class**: `measurement-hygiene`

## 為什麼（because）

The 2026-09-09 sweet-spot log was read as '5976 slots = layer 0 in the pool', and 5976 was treated as a fingerprint of the pooled-40 configuration. Measured 2026-09-16: `llama_expert_cache: LAYER_CAPS per-layer caps: total 5976 slots (avg 145.8/layer, min 143/layer)` is printed IDENTICALLY in the skip0=1 arm (39 pooled layers) and the skip0=0 arm (40 pooled layers), because it is the planned sum of LAYER_CAPS (40 x 143 + 256 for the MTP layer) and does not consult the pooled-layer set at all. What actually discriminates the two arms is the teardown pool-integrity scan: owner-set slots 5793 -> 5935 (a delta of exactly +142, one layer's worth) and zero-regions 0 -> 4 (all four in layer 0, first at layer=0 slot=18 kind=0 owner_expert=252). Same disease as eng-gate-0010: a recorded value read as behaviour.

## 反例（counterexample_observed）

`total 5976 slots` identical across two arms that differ by exactly one pooled layer, with 2026-09-09 treating that same number as proof that layer 0 was pooled.
